meta.name: competitive-analysis-process
meta.description: Orchestrate a complete competitive analysis across six steps, from landscape to strategic direction. Use when you need the full picture, not a single scan or card.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完整走一遍竞争分析,从市场格局到战略方向
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全局看清竞争态势并推导战略方向
copy.tagline_en: Run a complete competitive analysis, from market landscape to strategic direction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a full competitive picture to guide strategic decisions

howto.what: Claude会引导你完成一套完整的竞争分析流程，覆盖市场概览、产品对比、客户需求、商业信息、定位与战略方向六个步骤，最后生成作战卡片、对比矩阵、定位反击和威胁评估四类成果。
howto.when: 当你需要竞争全景分析而非单点扫描或卡片，例如新战略周期开始，或手头有零散情报想系统整理时。

say.text: 对中型市场薪资软件行业做一次完整竞争分析，决策是守低端还是推高端。
say.note: Claude会先确认范围和已有资料，再按流程推进。

say.text: 我有很多零散的竞对资料，帮我按这个流程整理成作战卡片和威胁简报。
say.note: Claude会利用已有情报，跳过重复步骤，直接产出可用成果。

say.text: 只针对主要竞对做深度分析，用于大客户单子防守，请推荐要跑的步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates a six-step competitive analysis (landscape, product, customer needs, business baseline, positioning, strategy) and outputs battle cards, comparison matrices, positioning counter-moves, and threat assessments.
howto.when_en: When you need the full picture, not a single scan or card — e.g., a new strategy cycle or scattered intel to organize.

say_en.text: Full competitive analysis on mid-market payroll; decision: defend low end or push up?
say_en.note: Claude will scope, then run the six-step process.

say_en.text: Scattered competitor data; organize into battle cards and a threat brief.
say_en.note: It reuses existing intel and skips redundant steps.

say_en.text: Deep-dive one competitor for deal defense; recommend which steps to run.
say_en.note: It suggests a subset and builds a targeted battle card.
